panels.description: Sitara and Roman stand beside aligned records as Nayah works the route line; phone beside Orien rings. Leave upper-right clear.
Sitara answers while Roman watches with treatment file in hand. Leave upper-left clear.
Orien appears only on the cracked phone screen, frost-stiffened and weak, breath interrupting speech. Leave upper third clear.
Roman lowers the treatment file as the call drops; phone screen goes dark. Leave upper-right clear.

items.speaker: ORIEN
items.text: Croft threatened me. The warnings were scheduled… in case I disappeared.

items.speaker: ORIEN
items.text: Second timestamp. Do not release everything. Release what can be checked.
